task_description: Refactor the monolithic 1538-line Lambda handler (apps/api/src/handler.ts) into multiple domain-specific Lambda handlers with shared utilities. Split into four handlers: recipes (CRUD + import), ingredients-on-hand (CRUD), supermarkets (CRUD), and sort-ingredients (AI operations). Update CDK stack to create four separate Lambda functions with appropriate route integrations and IAM permissions.

verification.summary: pnpm nx build api passes (TypeScript type-checking), pnpm nx build infra passes (CDK compiles), pnpm nx lint api passes (all files clean). No test files exist for the API project so test_quality is pass by default. Docker build skipped (no Docker daemon). All four handler files type-check correctly, CDK stack correctly defines four Lambda functions with proper route integrations and IAM permissions. Review issues addressed: sort-ingredients DynamoDB over-permissioning fixed, barrel imports replaced with direct file imports to avoid unnecessary SDK initialization, and duplicated AI response-parsing logic consolidated into parseAndMatchGroups helper.
